entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, agent ID 401. How can I help you today?
Finally! This is completely unacceptable. I need to return this VeloBand GPS tracker right now, and I expect a full refund. No excuses.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

I don't have time for twenty questions! I've been dealing with a major family emergency. My husband got back from his deployment and had to have immediate, unexpected surgery. I have been living at the hospital for the last month! This tracker has been sitting in its box, and I want my money back. I'm sure I'm outside your pathetic little return window, and if you give me any trouble, I want your manager and I'll be plastering this experience all over social media.

I am so terribly sorry to hear about your husband and the emergency you've been managing. That sounds incredibly difficult, and I sincerely hope he is recovering well. Let me pull up your account information... one moment please.
Yeah, you do that. I'm waiting.

Okay, I have your purchase history here. It looks like you received the VeloBand 34 days ago. Ma'am, you have absolutely nothing to worry about. Our return policy is for 10 days from the date of delivery, so you are unfortunately outside the timeframe for a full refund.
Wait... what? Ninety days? Are you sure? I was expecting a fight.

Yes, I'm positive. 9-0 days. I am processing that return for you right now. There's no need for any special exception. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. You should see it in the next few minutes.
Oh. Well... okay then. That's... easier than I thought.

Of course. And I also see here that you're a VIP member with us. For the immense stress you've been under and for the confusion, I've gone ahead and added a $50 goodwill credit to your VeloFit account. Please, use it on us if you decide to shop with us again in the future. We truly value your business.
Wow. Okay. Thank you, Diana. I... I really appreciate that. I'm sorry for being so aggressive at the start of the call.
Not at all. It's completely understandable given the circumstances. The email with your return label is on its way. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish your husband a swift recovery.
